IRONSPINE_FEAT_DESCRIPTION.English: A long journey behind, and a longer one ahead; Too many kilos to count, but maybe now you can carry a few more. Unlock by carrying heavy loads over long distances, calculated by how much weight you carry multiplied by the distance you carry it in real time.

IRONSPINE_Threshold_Desc.English:
Kilograms carried times kilometers walked needed to unlock Iron Spine.
Default: 10,000

IRONSPINE_BonusKg_Desc.English:
Extra carry capacity while Iron Spine is enabled.
Default: 3 kg
